name: oh to _
what_it_is: Oh, to _ voices a wistful 'if only I could _.' Creators usually open lifestyle, travel or nostalgia clips with this dreamy, longing line. The blank names the desired experience or state, e.g. 'be in your twenties with your best friend in NYC for fall.'
